metric_notes.win_rate_pct: percent of trades with a positive net USD result
metric_notes.profit_factor_ratio: gross profit / gross loss in net USD
metric_notes.sharpe_ratio: annualised from daily New York-close returns (x sqrt(260), risk-free 0)
metric_notes.max_drawdown_pct: largest fall of marked-to-market equity from its running peak, in percent (positive)

result.trades_note: the per-trade list is stored in object storage (MinIO), which the research agent does not read
